definitions.gloss: commuting expenses; commuting allowance; transportation costs to and from work
definitions.explanation: The money spent on transportation between home and the workplace. In Japan, employers typically reimburse this in full as a separate line item on the paycheck.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}が{通勤費|つうきんひ}を{出|だ}してくれる。
{通勤費|つうきんひ}は{月|つき}に{二万円|にまんえん}ほどかかる。
examples.english: Commuting expenses come to about 20,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}の{条件|じょうけん}として{通勤費|つうきんひ}{全額|ぜんがく}{支給|しきゅう}は{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Full coverage of commuting expenses is an important condition when changing jobs.

notes:
Compound of {通勤|つうきん} (commuting) + {費|ひ} (expenses, fee). A standard item in Japanese employment terms. Usually reimbursed via a monthly commuter pass ({定期券|ていきけん}) or actual fare paid.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通勤費|つうきんひ}{支給|しきゅう}: provision of commuting expenses
- {通勤費|つうきんひ}{全額|ぜんがく}{支給|しきゅう}: full commuting expenses covered
- {通勤費|つうきんひ}を{請求|せいきゅう}する: to claim commuting expenses
- {通勤費|つうきんひ}{込|こ}み: commuting expenses included

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {交通費|こうつうひ}: transportation expenses — broader term, includes any work-related travel, not just commuting
- {通勤手当|つうきんてあて}: commuting allowance — the formal name on a paycheck
- {定期代|ていきだい}: cost of a commuter pass
